# Rubric

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Rubric`](gmeow-Rubric.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Rubric>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A norm for judging — a reified evaluation framework whose criteria, poles, scales, and anchors are first-class content. Being a [`Norm`](gmeow-Norm.md), a rubric names its issuer (no anonymous evaluation standards), may be overridden, and carries authority within its issuing system. Applying a rubric is solver work; the results come back as vantage-indexed Assessments ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)). Member criteria attach via [`gmeow:hasCriterion`](../properties/gmeow-hasCriterion.md) (⊑ [`gmeow:hasPart`](../properties/gmeow-hasPart.md)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Norm`](gmeow-Norm.md), [`gmeow:SocialObject`](gmeow-SocialObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Rubric`](gmeow-Rubric.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Norm`](gmeow-Norm.md), [`gmeow:SocialObject`](gmeow-SocialObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Norm`](gmeow-Norm.md), [`gmeow:SocialObject`](gmeow-SocialObject.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a reified evaluation framework — a norm for judging whose criteria, poles, scales, and anchors are first-class content, issued and overridable like any norm.

### Avoid when

- Avoid baking the scoring function into triples (applying a rubric is permanently solver work — [Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12); results return as Assessments) and avoid an anonymous rubric (being a [`Norm`](gmeow-Norm.md), it must name its issuer).

### How to use

- Mint the rubric, name its issuer, attach criteria with [`gmeow:hasCriterion`](../properties/gmeow-hasCriterion.md), set a default scale with [`gmeow:usesScale`](../properties/gmeow-usesScale.md); applying it yields vantage-indexed [`gmeow:Assessment`](gmeow-Assessment.md) cells, never asserted scores.

### Examples

- ex:voiceRubric a [`gmeow:Rubric`](gmeow-Rubric.md); [`gmeow:systemIssuer`](../properties/gmeow-systemIssuer.md) ex:editorial; [`gmeow:hasCriterion`](../properties/gmeow-hasCriterion.md) ex:agency; [`gmeow:usesScale`](../properties/gmeow-usesScale.md) ex:zeroToOne.
